title: Pjama feature
description: A Pjama feature: an ordered sequence of edits to a map, the reviews deciding on them and everyone taking part. This schema only checks types: references between entries, append-only order, versions and conflicts are checked by the code that applies edits. UUIDs come from the map schema, which must be registered under the id map.schema.json.

$schema.description: Location of this JSON Schema, for editors and tools. It doesn't state which version of the feature model the feature follows: see schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the feature model the feature is written in, as v<MAJ>.<MIN>.<PATCH>. This schema only accepts features written in its own version.

name.description: Name of the feature. Absent for the unnamed feature that collects edits made without naming one.

parent.description: Where the feature starts from: the id of another feature, or 'map' for the map itself.

participants.description: Everyone taking part in the feature, authors and reviewers alike. Edits and reviews refer to them by id.

status.description: Whether the feature is still open or its edits have been merged into the map.

edits.description: The feature's edits, in the order they reached the daemon. Append-only.

reviews.description: The reviews of the feature's edits, in the order they were made. Append-only.

timestamp.description: Date and time in RFC 3339 format, e.g. 2026-11-08T14:30:00Z.

version.description: A value of the global version: an integer counting the edits that have reached the daemon.

json.description: Any JSON value. Not checked against the map schema.

targetId.description: The object an operation or dependency is about: an item, relationship or layout entry by id, or the map or the layout itself.

target.description: A field of an object, or the whole object when field is absent.

field.description: Name of the field. Absent for the whole object.

entityKind.description: What a create or delete acts on.

participant.description: Someone taking part in a feature, as an author or a reviewer.

kind.description: Whether the participant is a human, an agent or another kind.

operation.description: One step of an edit's transaction.

createOperation.description: Creates an object. The created object, id included, is the new value.

deleteOperation.description: Deletes an object, carrying a full copy of it so the delete can be undone.

setOperation.description: Sets one field of an object to a new value, whole.

newValue.description: The field's value after the operation.

oldValue.description: The field's value before the operation.

unsetOperation.description: Removes one field of an object.

oldValue.description: The field's value before the operation.

edit.description: A change to the map: a transaction of operations with its author, source and versions. An edit depends on every field and object it changes.

description.description: What the edit does, generated when the edit is created.

author.description: Id of the participant who made the edit.

needsReview.description: Whether the edit needs review. With no review, an edit that needs one is pending, otherwise approved.

baseVersion.description: The global version the author saw when making the edit.

resultingVersion.description: The global version produced when the edit reached the daemon.

dependsOn.description: Fields or objects the edit was made with in mind, besides the ones it changes.

transaction.description: The edit's operations, applied in order, all or none.

amendsEdit.description: Id of the pending, rejected or returned edit this one amends.

revertsEdit.description: Id of the edit this one reverts.

review.description: A decision on an edit. An edit's status is its latest review.

edit.description: Id of the edit the review decides on.

status.description: The decision: approved, rejected, or returned to the author for changes.

by.description: Id of the participant who made the review.
